description: Manages the classification and types of documents associated with various entities within the system.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated and sortable list of document types, optionally filtered by the entity they are associated with. This endpoint supports filtering by `entityName`, pagination using `pageIndex` and `pageSize`, and sorting by `orderBy` field in `ascending` or `descending` order.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to filter document types by (e.g., 'Partner', 'Contact').

pageIndex.description: The 0-based index of the page to retrieve.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

orderBy.description: The field name to sort the results by.

ascending.description: Specifies the sort order: true for ascending, false for descending.

example_uses: Get all document types for the 'Partner' entity.
List the first 10 document types, sorted by name, for any entity.
Retrieve document types for 'Contact' entity, showing the second page with 20 items.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch a list of predefined document types, especially when you want to see which types are available for a specific business entity like 'Partner' or 'Contact', or when you need to paginate and sort the results.
